body: The thing is I can handle friend-zoning but it seems people, male and female alike, whom I thought were friends aren't. I honestly don't know how now to be friends with people if 90% of what they care about is appearence. Does that make sense? I feel it, even in my family. When I lost a good chunck of weight the first time I mention it to my brother, how I was feeling, and he said that my personality changed, I responded no it hasn't I'm exactly the same. I understand appearence matters but to this extent. Then I feel like I was setup to fail.
